There should also be transparency about when and how AI is being used, so individuals are not blindsided by its implementation, as she felt she was. She feels it is important for the community to have a say in how such powerful technologies are adopted and to ensure that the benefits of AI do not come at the cost of widespread unemployment and economic instability for its members. The thought brings a fresh wave of anxiety about her own future and the broader societal changes she is now directly experiencing.
